basic: Production sheet for Nahida NORMAL-PROPORTION version of a pixel-art side-scrolling fighting game. Reference is the NEW normal-proportion Nahida, NOT chibi. EXACTLY 16 fully isolated full-body poses in a precise 4-column 4-row layout, transparent background. Fixed side-on battle camera, all facing RIGHT. Preserve exact reference costume, white hair with green tips, leaf ornament, pointed ears, sandals. Head height about one fifth of standing body height, slim youthful child limbs, same head SIZE in all poses, still a short child not an adult. Consistent detailed pixel-art style. No giant eyes or chibi/stubby proportions, no effects/glow/haze/scene/grid/labels/text, no weapon. Full figure and hair inside each cell with large transparent gutter. Standing actors use 60% cell height; same scale for crouch/jump/down, do NOT enlarge crouching head. Grounded foot baseline consistent. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs, correct hands. Row1: idle-ready 1; idle breath 2; walking right left-foot contact; walking passing. Row2: walking right-foot contact; crouching ready; standing guard hands in front of upper chest; crouching low guard. Row3: jump anticipation bending knees; rising in air knees tucked; descending in air legs extending; landing bent knees. Row4: standing hurt torso recoils; airborne hurt tilted but still full side view; knocked down lying completely horizontal on back at floor; getting up on one knee hands braced. Last pose is get-up, not idle. No magical effects.
